verdict.rationale: Discord's first-party blog describes Threads as a way to branch a conversation off a channel's main feed without removing it from the channel, so side discussions stay with their context. Private Threads are also available on desktop and mobile. missing for 10: explicit documentation that a thread anchors to a specific originating message, in-depth product docs beyond a blog post, admin-level thread management controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
